new_page.h1: Cariboo Condos for Sale | Burnaby Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Cariboo. No building list, strata fees, street boundaries or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Cariboo condos and townhomes in Burnaby: 23 listed at the end of October 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. That makes Cariboo number 12 of 35 Burnaby communities by condo and townhome listings. Houses in Cariboo have their own page; this page is only about attached homes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo and townhome listings in Cariboo rose from 20 in June to 23 in October (+15.0%), while 11 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.8% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condo and townhome listings.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Cariboo?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 23 condos and townhomes listed in Cariboo. That is a month-end count and moves daily; ask Jared for what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cariboo a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Cariboo had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos sold in Cariboo from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 11 condos and townhomes sold in Cariboo over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so any count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
